definitions.full: H2062. Zeeb II. זְאֵב proper name, masculine ( wolf ) — a prince of Midian, Judg 7:25 (3 t. in verse); 8:3 ; Psa 83:12 ; also in proper name, of a location יֶקֶבזְֿאֵב Judg 7:25 wine-vat of Zeeb .
